item.title: Researchers Find Structured Human–AI Collaboration Is Required for Creative Gains
item.description: What generative AI typically does best – recognise patterns and predict the next step in a sequence – can seem fundamentally at odds with the intangibility of human creativity and imagination. However, Cambridge researchers suggest that AI can be a useful creative partner, as long as there is clear guidance on how ideas should be developed together. item.title: How good people justify bending the rules at work — and what leaders can do about it
item.description: Lorne Michael Hartman, University of Toronto; York University, CanadaImage: Charles Forerunner / UnsplashConsider the following scenario. You’re facing pressure to meet quarterly targets, but the numbers aren’t quite where they need to be. With a deadline looming, you “round up” a figure just slightly to make the results look better. This kind of thinking is far more common than many realize. Research in behavioural ethics shows these subtle choices are exactly how unethical behaviour takes root

item.title: 43% of Web Requests Come from Mobile, Cloudflare Data Shows
item.description: According to Cloudflare's Year in Review, published on 15 December 2025, Global internet traffic increased by 19 percent in 2025, with growth accelerating after August. Cloudflare's global network spans 330 cities across more than 125 regions and handled an average of over 81 million HTTP requests per second. item.description: If you “reach out” and “circle back” often in your work emails, you’re not alone. These phrases are among the most overused email clichés around the world, a new study finds. item.title: Study Finds Americans Overestimate Harmful Behavior on Social Media
item.description: A study published in PNAS Nexus reports that Americans consistently overestimate how many social media users post harmful content online. Across three national studies involving 1,090 U.S. adults, participants believed large shares of users on platforms such as Reddit and Facebook engaged in toxic language or shared false news. item.title: Global Report Flags Rising Use of Digital Controls to Suppress Dissent
item.description: A 2025 report by the University of Rhode Island’s Center for Nonviolence and Peace Studies documents a global rise in what researchers describe as digital repression by governments. item.title: JP Conte: Five Things You Need To Successfully Build Strategic Partnerships [Promoted]
item.description: Private equity professionals often speak about returns, multiples, and exit timelines. JP Conte, managing partner of a San Francisco-based private equity firm and founder of family office Lupine Crest Capital, tends to speak about something else: relationships. Over a career spanning three decades — one that has seen his firm grow from approximately $100 million to $49 billion in assets under management — Conte has developed a distinctive philosophy about what makes partnerships succeed or fail.
